title: KP product roadmap v5 continuation v2

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved predecessor closed after pressure decomposition materialized narrow structured-algebra actions.

allowedWork: Finish structured algebra, pressure-test fraction composition, add governed semantic and LLM authoring, and promote the approved bounded breadth exemplars in dependency order.

Extract only contracts proven by exemplars, preserve accepted semantic documents and measured-motion ownership, use shared routes and verification, and commit each reversible slice with durable evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not generalize a subjective visual pattern before its human exemplar approval, bypass dependency order, or overwrite unrelated user-authored roadmap and design work.

Do not add LLM-authored DOM, CSS, pixels, arbitrary keyframes, unchecked math, course-scale curriculum, dynamic package loading, parked FTC, BFS, economics, programming, physics work, or broad WebGL generalization.
goal: Continue the approved dependency-ordered product frontier through structured algebra, fraction composition, governed semantic and LLM authoring, and bounded exemplar breadth.
commitCadence: Commit each independently reversible verified slice with its Theseus evidence; never mix user-authored unrelated document edits into a slice commit.
stopConditions: H1 HUMAN-EXEMPLAR: stop at every required visual or interaction exemplar checkpoint until the user reviews generated evidence.
H2 SCOPE: stop if work would exceed the five approved goals, revive a deferred area, or generalize beyond exemplar evidence.
H3 DEPENDENCY: stop if a later goal would begin before its required predecessor is verified and resolved.
H4 PRESERVATION: stop if accepted semantic documents, measured-motion ownership, reader routing, URL state, accessibility, or approved visual parity cannot be preserved.
H5 VERIFICATION: stop if a required focused, boundary, release, or Theseus validation gate fails without a bounded in-scope repair.
H6 USER-OVERLAP: stop if a required edit cannot be separated from unrelated user-authored worktree changes.
H7 AUTHORITY: stop if required external mutation or destructive work exceeds the user's approval.

slices.title: Add verified rewrite laws and deterministic diagnostics
slices.summary: Distribution rewrites now require lawful structured topology and emit stable lineage or path-addressed rejection diagnostics.

slices.summary: Normal-form plans now require registered semantic intent, verified roots, and complete requested lineage while renderer-shaped fields remain outside the contract.

slices.summary: The accepted distribution presentation is now projected from structured semantic expressions, verified role bindings, and compiled normal-form lineage rather than semantic LaTeX templates.

slices.summary: Structured algebra is closed behind semantic-only contracts with exact renderer projection, full reader conformance, and durable visual evidence.

slices.title: Prove opaque fraction fan-out over structured subtrees
slices.summary: Added a structured fraction fan-out fixture for 2/3(x+6), preserving stable descendant identities beneath copied quotient roots. Focused tests, 1937-test regression suite, typecheck, and production build passed.

slices.title: Prove sequential and parallel numerator normalization
slices.summary: Normalized each distributed fraction term into an explicit quotient numerator while keeping scheduling presentation-only. Sequential and parallel policies share one immutable semantic outcome; focused tests, full regression, and typecheck passed.

slices.title: Compose fraction terms inside distributed sums
slices.summary: Composed the independently normalized quotient branches into one structured distributed sum, preserving authored order and exact term identities. Focused composition tests and typecheck passed.

slices.title: Prove verified reverse factoring for fraction expressions
slices.summary: Added verified reverse factoring as an explicit inverse of the distribution authority. Fan-out lineage reverses to fan-in, while opaque quotient drift is rejected with deterministic paths. Focused tests and typecheck passed.

slices.title: Compose the lawful fraction solve macro
slices.summary: Composed a 14-state renderer-neutral solve macro for 2/3(x+6)=10 from the verified fan-out, normalization, sum-composition, inverse, balance, cancellation, and arithmetic authorities. Every adjacent step is continuous and every state independently verifies the exact solution x=9.

slices.title: Run fraction architecture visual and primitive-amortization checkpoint
slices.summary: Human approved the fraction architecture and visual checkpoint. The renderer-neutral pressure test is accepted, the existing reader remains preserved, and fraction-specific macro contracts stay exemplar-local pending further evidence.

slices.title: Add the constrained governed semantic authoring schema
slices.summary: Added a deeply immutable referential authoring schema: providers select verified source IDs, exact pack pins, registered semantic operations, correspondence, named focus and cadence, registered normal forms, and evidence-preserving compression. Raw math text, rendering, geometry, timing, typography, and selector authority are rejected. Focused tests and repository typecheck passed.

slices.title: Add deterministic authoring compilation rejection repair and provenance
slices.summary: Added deterministic governed semantic compilation against verified source revisions and exact operation pins. Invalid references, roles, correspondence, normal forms, provenance, and unsafe author authority return typed repair diagnostics with no fallback; accepted plans derive immutable governance and provenance with stable fingerprints.

slices.title: Prove and review one governed LLM authoring exemplar
slices.summary: Human approved the governed fraction fan-out exemplar and bounded provider/compiler authority split. The request and compiler are accepted without authorizing a live prompt API or presentation control.

slices.title: Promote the radical and exponent exemplar
slices.summary: Promoted the exponent and radical exemplar at the human gate. The approved radical uses continuous simultaneous diagonal-and-overbar growth; the later point-seed variant was rejected and reverted. Broad tests, build, visual capture, and radical browser continuity passed.

slices.title: Promote the functional wrapping exemplar
slices.summary: Promoted the function-wrap exemplar at the human gate. x reflows before enclosure and function entry, settles exactly to native f(x), and reconstructs on rewind. Added stable visual capture; 1,974 tests, typecheck, focused browser motion, and build passed. Recorded that ordinary learner lessons must not inherit editor flat-focus token boxes.
